senses.gloss: f. (a corrupt. of sellula) a little chair or stool.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9:4">Lev. R. s. 9</cite> (mixed dict.) <he>יהבו</he> (<he>ליה</he>) <he>לו ס׳ וישב עליה</he> give him a stool that he may seat himself on it; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 493:4">Yalk. ib. 493</cite> <he>יהבו ליה סלריא ויתיב עליה</he> (corr. acc.).
